recent.title: RECURRENT NEURAL NETWORK AND TRAINING PROCESS FOR SAME

patents.source: USPTO Open Data Portal, granted patents since 2001, applicant phrase "nnaisense", 2026-09-24

profile_text.body:
NNAISENSE is a for-profit startup founded in 2014 and headquartered in Lugano, Switzerland. According to its website, it is building a quantitative multi-strategy hedge fund that combines generative AI with institutional portfolio management. The company says the fund will trade global equity, futures and other derivatives across multiple markets, aiming for low correlation with both the market and other active strategies, and it is taking waitlist signups.

The company describes its models as custom in-house systems rather than generic large language models. It names two: Bayesian Flow Networks (BFNs) and a Large Investing Model (LIM), which it says simulate entire future market scenarios instead of predicting individual assets. It also describes a Risk Control Room for continuous monitoring of data quality, model accuracy and portfolio exposures.

NNAISENSE states that it has worked with ACATIS Investment KVG mbH and other financial institutions on stock selection and portfolio construction technology, and that this collaboration led to ACATIS acquiring NNAISENSE in 2025. No products, lawsuits or other registry entries for the company are recorded.
